blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) encode linguistic structures remains a fundamental challenge in interpretability research. While diagnostic classifiers (or "probes") are widely used for this task, they face significant methodological criticism: training auxiliary classifiers introduces capacity confounds and calibration issues, often making it difficult to distinguish the model’s intrinsic representations from the probe’s ability to learn the task. To address these limitations, we introduce a probe-free framework for localizing linguistic selectivity at the individual neuron level. Leveraging the controlled contrasts of linguistic minimal pairs, we propose a Neuron Separability Index (NSI), a metric that directly quantifies how reliably single neurons differentiate grammatical from ungrammatical constructions without parameter updates. Applying NSI across 68 linguistic paradigms and seven checkpoints reveals three main patterns: 1) raw separability reaches near-peak levels earlier for morphological and syntactic distinctions than for syntax–semantics interface and conceptual distinctions. 2) after permutation normalization, single-unit selectivity is sparse, weak, and narrowly tuned: only a small fraction of units are sensitive to an average paradigm, and strongly selective “grandmother neurons” are rare. 3) whole-vector linear separability, single-neuron selectivity, and behavioral competence are largely dissociated, and targeted ablations further separate activation selectivity from causal reliance.
blocks.zh: 理解大语言模型(LLMS)如何编码语言结构仍然是解释性研究的根本挑战. 虽然诊断分类器(或"probes")被广泛用于这一任务,但他们面临重大的方法学批评:培训辅助分类器引入了能力混乱和校准问题,常常使得模型的内在表达与探测器学习任务的能力难以区分. 为了消除这些局限性,我们引入了一个无探针框架,使个别神经元层次的语言选择性本地化。 利用语言最小对子的可控对比度,我们提出Neuron分离指数(NSI),这个指标直接量化单个神经元如何可靠地区分语法和非语法构造,而不更新参数. 在68个语言范式和7个检查站实施国家调查揭示了三个主要模式: 1) 原始分离性在形态学和合成区分方面比语法-语义界面和概念区分方面更早达到近峰水平. 2) 常态化后,单单位选择性很少,很弱,而且调性很窄:只有一小部分单位对一般模式敏感,而且极具选择性的“祖母神经元”很少。 3)全源性线性分离,单中子选择性,行为能力基本不相干,有针对性地将激活选择性与因果依赖进一步分离.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding how large language models (LLMs) encode linguistic structure remains a central challenge for interpretability. A recurring question concerns granularity : is a grammatical distinction carried by a small number of highly selective units, in the spirit of the long-debated “grandmother neuron” hypothesis in neuroscience ( Kanwisher et al., 1997 ; Gross, 2002 ; Quiroga et al., 2005 ; Posani et al., 2025 ) , or is it spread thinly across many units, each contributing only weakly? Work on superposition and polysemanticity suggests that neither extreme is guaranteed: single units can mix multiple features, so apparent selectivity may depend on which contrasts one happens to test ( Elhage et al., 2022 ; Bills et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . Sparse feature discovery can partially disentangle such mixtures, but the recovered directions are not automatically complete, atomic, or tied to model behavior, which makes unit-level functional claims difficult to establish ( Bricken et al., 2023 ; Cunningham et al., 2024 ; Makelov et al., 2025 ; Leask et al., 2025 ) . Settling the granularity question therefore requires a measurement that is defined at the level of individual units, comparable across many linguistic phenomena, and free of auxiliary training.
blocks.zh: 理解大语言模型(LLMS)编码语言结构仍然是解释性的中心挑战. 一个反复出现的问题涉及颗粒性:根据神经科学中长期争论的“祖母神经元”假说的精神,少数极具选择性的单位是语法上的区别(Kanwisher等人,1997年;Gross等人,2002年;Quiroga等人,2005年;Posani等人,2025年),还是分散在许多单位中,每个单位的作用都很小? 关于叠位和多聚体抗体的研究表明,两个极端都没有保障:单单元可以混合多个特征,因此,明显的选择性可能取决于测试结果的对比(Elhage等人,2022年;Bills等人,2023年;Huang等人,2024年)。 Sparse特征的发现可以部分地使这些混合物脱钩,但回收方向并不自动完整,原子化,或与模型行为挂钩,这使得单位一级的功能主张难以确定(Bricken等人,2023年;Cunningham等人,2024年;Makelov等人,2025年;Leask等人,2025年). 因此,要解决颗粒性问题,就需要在单个单位一级加以界定,在许多语言现象中进行比较,并且没有辅助培训。

blocks.en: Existing evidence comes from three lines of work, none of which supplies such a measurement. Targeted minimal-pair evaluation established that language models capture a wide range of grammatical dependencies ( Linzen et al., 2016b ; Marvin & Linzen, 2018 ; Warstadt et al., 2020 ; Misra et al., 2023 ; Jumelet et al., 2025 ) , but it treats the model as a black box and says nothing about internal organization. Representation analyses open the box and map where linguistic information is decodable across depth ( Tenney et al., 2019 ; Starace et al., 2023 ; He et al., 2024 ) , yet a trained probe reads out a whole activation vector and contributes its own capacity, so its success is silent about whether any individual unit carries the distinction ( Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ; Pimentel et al., 2020 ; Belinkov, 2022 ) . Mechanistic interpretability does reach individual units ( Lakretz et al., 2019 ; Geva et al., 2021 ; Finlayson et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) , but each study is built around one or two phenomena, leaving open whether strong single-unit selectivity is the normal case or a rare exception across the grammar as a whole. We discuss all three lines in detail in Section A .
blocks.zh: 现有证据来自三条工作线,没有一条线能提供这种测量。 有针对性的最小派评价确定语言模型能捕捉到广泛的语法依赖性(Linzen等人,2016b;Marvin & Linzen等人,2018;Warstadt等人,2020;Misra等人,2023;Jumelet等人,2025),但它将模型视为一个黑匣子,对内部组织一言不发. 表现分析打开了语言信息可解码跨深度的盒子和地图(Tenney等人,2019年;Starace等人,2023年;He等人,2024年),然而训练有素的探针读出了整个激活载体,贡献了自身的能力,因此它的成功是没有提及是否有任何个体单位具有这种区别(Hewitt & Liang,2019年;Pimentel等人,2020年;Belinkov,2022年). 机械可解释性确实达到单个单位(Lakretz等人,2019年;Geva等人,2021年;Finlayson等人,2021年;Meng等人,2022年),但每项研究都是围绕一两个现象构建的,对于强单单位选择性是正常情况还是整个语法中罕见的例外,尚有保留. 我们将在A节详细讨论所有三行。

blocks.en: The open question, then, is quantitative and comparative: if a model behaves grammatically, how much of that competence is expressed in individual neurons, and is such selectivity broad (domain-general) or narrow (domain-specific)? We address it with a probe-free neuron-level framework that exploits the controlled contrasts of minimal pairs. Combining BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) and COMPS ( Misra et al., 2023 ) , we organize the suite into a three-level hierarchy of 4 domains, 13 phenomena, and 68 paradigms, so that selectivity can be compared on a common scale from a single agreement contrast up to entire linguistic domains. For each paradigm we feed matched grammatical and ungrammatical sentences into a language model, extract last-token activations, and, for each neuron independently, compute a correlation-derived raw separability score between its paired positive and negative activation vectors. Because minimal pairs differ in as little as one token, this contrast is tightly controlled, and because the score is read directly off the activations, it requires no parameter updates and no auxiliary classifier.
blocks.zh: 那么,尚未解决的问题是定量和比较的:如果一个模型在语法上的行为,这种能力有多少是以单个神经元表示的,这种选择性是广义的(域一般)还是狭义的(域特定)? 我们用一个无探测器的神经元水平框架来研究它 利用最小对子的可控对比 结合了BLIMP(Warstadt等人,2020年)和COMPS(Misra等人,2023年),我们组织该套套装,形成由4个域,13个现象,68个范式组成的三级层次,这样,选择性可以从一个单一协议与整个语言域形成对比,在共同尺度上进行比较. 对于每个范式,我们把匹配的语法句和非语法句子输入一个语言模型,提取最后的托肯激活,并且,对于每个神经元独立地计算出其配对的正向和负的激活向量之间的相关原始分离分数. 由于最小的对子和一个符号一样少,这种对比被严格控制,由于比分直接从激活中读出,因此不需要参数更新和辅助分类器.

blocks.en: Raw separability can still be inflated by lexical overlap or sampling noise. We therefore normalize it against a null distribution obtained by randomly swapping the grammatical labels within pairs, which preserves lexical content while destroying the grammatical contrast. The resulting Neuron Separability Index ( NSI ) expresses each neuron’s discrimination in units of its own null, making values comparable across neurons, layers, and paradigms: a high NSI indicates discrimination beyond what lexical content or noise explains, whereas a near-zero NSI indicates insensitivity to the targeted contrast.
blocks.zh: 原始的分离性仍然可以被词典上的重叠或取样噪音所夸大. 因此,我们使它正常化,防止通过在对子内随机互换语法标签而获得的无效分布,这既保留了语法内容,又破坏了语法对比. 由此形成的神经分泌指数(NSI)表达了每个神经元在自身单位中的歧视,使数值在神经元,层层和范式上具有可比性:高的NSI表明歧视超出了词汇内容或噪音所解释的范围,而接近零的NSI则表明对目标对比不敏感.

blocks.en: Applying this framework reveals a consistent but more nuanced picture. Raw separability reaches near-peak levels earlier for morphological and syntactic distinctions than for syntax–semantics interface and conceptual ones. After permutation normalization, however, the same activations yield a far more restrictive picture of single-unit selectivity: grammaticality-sensitive neurons are sparse, their effects are generally weak, and units meeting a strong-selectivity criterion are rare. Selectivity is also narrow, with even poly-selective neurons retaining a dominant within-domain preference rather than acting as general grammar detectors. This pattern replicates across seven checkpoints from four model families and survives our threshold and pairing controls.
blocks.zh: 采用这一框架可以发现一个一致但更细微的图象。 原始分离性在形态学和合成区别方面比语法-语义界面和概念界面更早达到近峰水平。 然而,在演化正常化之后,同样的激活产生一个更严格的单单位选择性图景:语法敏感神经元很少,其效应一般很弱,满足强选择性标准的单位很少见. 选择性也是狭义的,甚至多选择性神经元也保留了域内的主要偏好,而不是充当一般的语法检测器. 这种模式在四个模范家庭的7个检查站复制,并经受住了我们的门槛和配对控制。

blocks.en: Neuron-level selectivity also proves distinct from both whole-vector decodability and model behavior: probe accuracy is essentially unrelated to minimal-pair behavioral accuracy across paradigms, NSI is likewise only weakly associated with behavior, and targeted ablations of the rare above-threshold units and their highest-scoring same-layer neighbors are no more damaging than matched random ablations. Information can therefore be linearly decodable from a representation without being strongly localized to individual units, and neither property alone establishes that the model behaviorally relies on it. Our contributions are correspondingly threefold: a probe-free, permutation-normalized measure of unit-level selectivity; a systematic map of that selectivity across a three-level linguistic hierarchy; and an empirical dissociation between representational decodability, single-unit localization, and behavioral reliance.
blocks.zh: Neuron级的选择性也证明有别于全源解码和模型行为:探针精度本质上与跨范式的最小-pair行为精度无关,NSI同样也只与行为有微弱的联系,对稀有的超阈值单位及其最高得分的同层邻居的定点浮标没有比对随机浮标更有害. 因此,信息可以线性地解码从一个代表,而不会被强烈地本地化到单个单位,而光是财产并不能证明模型的行为依赖于它. 我们的贡献相应地有三重:一个无探针的、永久性的、正常的单位级选择性衡量标准;一个系统化的、跨越三个层次语言层次的选择性图;以及一种在代表性解码、单单位局部化和行为依赖之间的经验脱节。

blocks.en: We use minimal pairs from BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) and COMPS ( Misra et al., 2023 ) as a controlled testbed for grammatical and conceptual contrasts; full dataset details are provided in Appendix B . Across the combined suite, the targeted contrasts are organized into a three-level hierarchy (Domain → \rightarrow Phenomenon → \rightarrow Paradigm), spanning four domains, 13 phenomena, and 68 paradigms in total. A domain is the broadest grouping, a phenomenon groups related minimal-pair paradigms, and a paradigm is one specific benchmark contrast.

blocks.en:
To control for lexical effects and background noise, we employ a permutation test.
For each paradigm, we generate a null distribution by randomly swapping the grammatical/ungrammatical labels within exactly half of the minimal pairs ( M p / 2 M_{p}/2 ), while keeping the paired sentences themselves intact.
This procedure disrupts the systematic grammatical contrast while preserving the lexical content of each pair.
We repeat this process N perm = 500 N_{\text{perm}}=500 times to obtain a distribution of permutation scores { S k perm } k = 1 N perm \{S^{\text{perm}}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{N_{\text{perm}}} .

blocks.en: Overall, such neurons constitute only a small fraction of the model at any layer, indicating that grammaticality is not broadly encoded by most neurons. This sparsity is also domain-dependent: the mean proportion of sensitive neurons is approximately 8.27 % 8.27\% for Concept, 3.31 % 3.31\% for Syntax–Semantics Interface, 2.50 % 2.50\% for Syntax, and 3.88 % 3.88\% for Morphology. Thus, Concept recruits the largest pool, whereas the three grammatical domains remain much sparser. In addition, the layer-wise trends reveal a clear decay: the proportion of grammar-sensitive neurons is highest in early to middle layers and gradually diminishes toward deeper layers. This pattern suggests a functional redistribution across depth. As representations become more abstract, fewer neurons are dedicated to encoding local grammatical well-formedness, and more capacity is likely devoted to higher-level information such as semantic integration, reasoning, and discourse context.

blocks.en: One natural question is whether a given linguistic phenomenon is localized to a small set of “grandmother” neurons that respond strongly and selectively to that phenomenon. Using NSI, we find little evidence for such extreme localization. Figure 4 a shows that even after restricting attention to sensitive neurons (NSI > 0 {>}0 ), their average separability remains low (typically around ∼ 0.5 \sim 0.5 ). Consistently, for 65 of 68 paradigms, even the most selective neuron fails to reach NSI > 2 {>}2 , our operational threshold for strong selectivity. For each of the remaining three paradigms, Appendix Figure 12 shows that the threshold is exceeded by only one neuron out of the full network ( 28 28 layers × \times 1024 1024 neurons).
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,某一语言现象是否局部化为一小组“祖母”神经元,对这一现象作出有力和有选择的反应。 使用NSI,我们发现很少证据可以证明这种极端本地化. 图4 a显示,即使在将注意力限制在敏感神经元(NSI > 0 {>}0)之后,其平均可分离性仍然很低(通常约为 ∼ 0.5\sim 0.5)。 始终如一地,对于68种范式中的65种,即使是最有选择性的神经元也未能达到NSI > 2 {>}2,即我们强烈选择性的操作门槛. 对于其余三个范式中的每一个,附录图12显示,整个网络中只有一个神经元(28 28层×\times 1024 1024神经元)超过了门槛.

blocks.en: Together, these results suggest that grammatical contrasts are typically encoded in a distributed manner: instead of a single neuron reliably separating grammatical from ungrammatical minimal pairs, separability is spread across neurons whose individual effects are modest.
blocks.zh: 这些结果加在一起表明语法对比通常以分布式方式编码:与其说一个单一的神经元可靠地将语法与非语法的最小配对分开,而是将可分离性分布在单个效果不大的神经元之间.

Even within this subset, the average NSI remains small, indicating that sensitivity is generally weak rather than sharply selective. blocks.en: While Figure 3 a shows that only a small fraction of neurons are sensitive to any given paradigm, a complementary question is how many different paradigms a single neuron responds to. We define each neuron’s breadth as the number of paradigms for which it has NSI > 0 {>}0 . Figure 3 b shows that most neurons respond to only a small number of paradigms and that broadly responsive neurons are rare.
blocks.zh: 虽然图3 a显示只有一小部分神经元对任何给定的范式敏感,但一个互补的问题是单个神经元响应多少不同的范式. 我们把每个神经元的宽度定义为它拥有NSI的范式数量 > ○{>}○. 图3b显示,大多数神经元只响应少量的范式,广泛反应的神经元是罕见的.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the average number of responsive paradigms, phenomena, and domains per neuron. Breadth declines sharply in the early layers, remains low through the middle of the network, and increases modestly near the output. Together with the scarcity of NSI > 2 {>}2 units, this pattern supports a representation in which grammatical information is distributed across neurons with narrow, weak-to-moderate effects rather than concentrated in a few universally responsive units.
blocks.zh: 图5显示每个神经元反应范式、现象和域的平均数量。 面包在早期的地层急剧下降,通过网络中间保持低水平,并在产出附近适度增加. 再加上NSI > 2 QQ2单元的稀缺性,这种图案支持一种表达方式,语法信息分布于神经元之间,具有狭义,弱到中度效应,而不是集中在少数普遍反应单位.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Functional modularity in tuning across linguistic phenomena. The heatmap displays mean phenomenon-level NSI for neurons responsive to at least three phenomena. Rows are grouped by domain, and columns are hierarchically clustered neurons. The block structure shows that even poly-selective neurons retain dominant within-domain preferences rather than behaving as uniform cross-domain grammar detectors.
blocks.zh: 图6:跨语言现象调整中的功能模块化. 热映射显示至少对三种现象作出反应的神经元的NSI表示现象级. 行按域分组,列按等级分组神经元. 块状结构显示,即使多选择性神经元也保留了域内的主要偏好,而不是作为统一的跨域语法检测器行事.

blocks.en: Some neurons are poly-selective in the sense that they respond to at least three linguistic phenomena, but Figure 6 shows that this does not make them general-purpose grammar neurons. Clustering reveals clear blocks in which a unit has comparatively strong mean NSI for one phenomenon or a small group of related phenomena, while its responses elsewhere are weaker. Cross-phenomenon co-activation therefore resembles spillover around a dominant preference rather than uniformly strong selectivity across domains.
blocks.zh: 一些神经元是多选择性的,即它们至少对三种语言现象作出反应,但图6显示这并没有使它们成为通用的语法神经元. 分组揭示出一个单位对于一个现象或一小群相关现象具有相对强大的平均值NSI的清晰块块,而它在其他地方的反应则较弱. 因此,交叉闪电共振类似于围绕主导偏好而外溢,而不是在各领域具有一致的强烈选择性。

blocks.en: The conclusion does not depend on the exact cutoff. At NSI > 1 {>}1 , all paradigms retain at least one above-threshold unit, yet these units comprise only 0.094 % 0.094\% of the network on average. From NSI ≥ 1.645 {}\geq 1.645 through NSI > 3 {>}3 , only 3 of 68 paradigms contain any above-threshold unit, with one such unit per paradigm (Figure 7 c). In the clean one-prefix deletion subset, removing the critical contrast token reduces mean raw separability from 0.0753 0.0753 to 0.0011 0.0011 , while deleting a matched non-critical token leaves it at 0.0746 0.0746 . blocks.en: Whole-vector representations are highly linearly separable (mean layer-14 probe accuracy 0.917 0.917 ), while the same model’s mean BLiMP behavioral accuracy is 0.758 0.758 . Across paradigms the two are effectively unrelated (Pearson r = − 0.032 r=-0.032 ; Figure 7 d). For example, sentential_subject_island has perfect probe accuracy ( 1.000 1.000 ) but behavioral accuracy of only 0.238 0.238 . Thus, whole-vector linear separability, single-neuron NSI, and behavioral preference are empirically distinct quantities; neither probing nor NSI alone establishes causal use. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present NSI , a minimal-pair, probe-free neuron-level measure that localizes linguistic selectivity across layers and characterizes it consistently at the domain, phenomenon, and paradigm levels. The approach is simple, statistically principled, and complementary to mechanistic analyses. Targeted ablations of groups containing the three rare NSI > 2 {>}2 candidates and their highest-scoring same-layer neighbors yield no effect distinguishable from same-size random controls, reinforcing the distinction between activation selectivity and causal reliance. Future work will move beyond residual-coordinate ablation to connect neuron clusters to concrete causal circuits through patching and mediation analysis ( Vig et al., 2020 ) , and extend to multilingual minimal pairs.
blocks.zh: NSI是一种最小的无探测的神经元水平度量, 它将语言选择性分层本地化, 这种方法简单、有统计原则,是对机械分析的补充。 包含三个罕见的NSI > 2 QQ2候选人及其最高得分的同层邻居的定向组合,不会产生与同级随机控制区分的效果,加强了激活选择性和因果依赖之间的区别。 今后的工作将超越残留-坐标缩放,通过补丁和调解分析将神经元集群与混凝土因果电路连接起来(Vig等人,2020年),并扩展到多语种最小对数。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: NSI is a probe-free lens on neuron-level selectivity, but the results should be interpreted within the following scope.
blocks.zh: NSI是神经元级选择性上的无探针镜头,但结果应在以下范围内解释.

blocks.en: We study seven decoder-only checkpoints from the Qwen3, Pythia, TinyLlama, and Llama families; differences in corpora, tokenizers, architectures, objectives, or post-training could change sparsity and apparent localization. BLiMP and COMPS are controlled, templated English resources and under-represent natural discourse, pragmatics, gradient acceptability, and typologically diverse languages. The conclusions are therefore robust within the tested models and benchmarks, not universal.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了来自Qun3、Pythia、TinyLlama和Llama家族的七个唯一的解码检查点;在蝎子、装饰剂、建筑、目标或培训后的不同可能改变垃圾和明显的本地化。 BLIMP和COMPS由控制,模板化的英语资源和代表不足的自然语句,实用性,梯度可接受性,以及类型多样的语言. 因此,这些结论在经过检验的模式和基准中是有力的,不是普遍性的。

blocks.en: NSI quantifies activation separability, while our intervention tests whether selected residual coordinates have uniquely strong causal effects. These within-benchmark tests cover three paradigms in one checkpoint; held-out phenomena and circuit-level interventions such as activation patching and mediation would provide stronger generalization and causal tests.
blocks.zh: NSI将激活分离性量化,而我们的干预测试选择的剩余坐标是否具有独特的强烈的因果关系。 这些基准内测试涵盖一个检查站的三个范式;被搁置的现象和电路一级的干预,如激活补丁和调解,将提供更有力的概括和因果关系测试。

blocks.en: We use last-token layer outputs and treat each scalar dimension as a neuron. This can miss information at earlier positions, distributed over time, or expressed in attention and MLP signals; neuron definitions also vary across architectures. Alternative positions, components, and readouts may yield different selectivity patterns.
blocks.zh: 我们使用最后的托肯层输出, 将每个鳞片维度当作神经元。 这可能会错过早期位置的信息,随时间而分布,或者在注意和MLP信号中表达;神经元定义也因架构而异. 备选位置、组件和读出可能会产生不同的选择性模式。

blocks.en: We use a matched within-pair permutation null that preserves lexical content while disrupting grammatical labels. Future work can model remaining lexical, tokenization, template, or item dependencies more explicitly. Robust normalization requires extensive permutation testing, but the independent permutations can be parallelized. Different similarity metrics emphasize distinct properties of neuronal responses. Although the sparse unit-level pattern persists under the Spearman and cosine variants (Appendix G ), future work could more systematically examine what metric-dependent differences reveal about neuronal response structure and linguistic selectivity.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个匹配的 内部穿插无效 保留词汇的内容 同时扰乱语法标签。 未来的工作可以更明确地模拟其余的词典化、象征性化、模板或项目依赖性。 强态正常化需要广泛的穿透测试,但独立的穿透可以平行. 不同的相似性衡量标准强调神经反应的不同性质. 虽然在Spearman和cosine变体(附录G)下,单位级的稀疏模式继续存在,但今后的工作可以更系统地审查依赖衡量的差别揭示神经反应结构和语言选择性。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: Evaluating the grammatical competence of language models has evolved from calculating overall perplexity to using targeted diagnostic datasets. Early work introduced small-scale, hand-crafted test suites to verify specific syntactic generalizations ( Linzen et al., 2016a ; Gulordava et al., 2018 ; Marvin & Linzen, 2018 ; Wilcox et al., 2018 ) . This methodology was significantly scaled up with benchmarks like BLiMP ( Warstadt et al., 2020 ) and automated platforms such as SyntaxGym ( Gauthier et al., 2020 ) , which use minimal pairs to isolate grammatical phenomena and reveal systematic gaps in LM performance, and was subsequently broadened to systematic syntactic generalization suites and to conceptual and multilingual coverage ( Hu et al., 2020 ; Mueller et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025a ) . High benchmark accuracy is nonetheless difficult to interpret on its own, as it can coexist with instability, prompt sensitivity, and divergence from human grammatical judgments ( Dentella et al., 2023 ; Hu & Levy, 2023 ; Mahowald et al., 2024 ) . More fundamentally, while these behavioral metrics effectively diagnose what linguistic rules a model violates, they treat the model as a black box, offering limited insight into where and how these distinctions are represented internally ( He et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 评估语言模型的语法能力已经从计算整体的复杂性发展到使用有针对性的诊断数据集. 早期工作引入了小规模,手工制作的测试套件,以验证具体的合成概括(Linzen等人,2016a;Gulordava等人,2018年;Marvin & Linzen,2018年;Wilcox等人,2018年). 该方法以BLimP(Warstadt等人,2020年)和ScienceGym(Gauthier等人,2020年)等自动化平台为基准大幅推广,这些平台使用最小对子来隔离语法现象,并揭示LM性能的系统性差距,随后被扩展为系统合成通用套件以及概念和多语种覆盖(Hu等人,2020年;Mueller等人,2020年;Liu等人,2024年;He等人,2025a年)。 然而,高基准准确性很难单独解释,因为它可能与不稳定、迅速的敏感性和与人类语法判断的分歧共存(Dentella等人,2023年;Hu & Levy,2023年;Mahowald等人,2024年)。 更根本的是,虽然这些行为衡量标准有效地诊断了一个模型违反什么语言规则,但是它们把模型当作一个黑匣子,对这些区别如何和如何在内部体现提供了有限的见解(He等人,2024年;He等人,2025年b ) 。

blocks.en: To understand internal representations, the community turned to diagnostic classifiers, or “probes.” Seminal layer-wise analyses demonstrated that classical NLP pipeline steps, such as part-of-speech tagging and parsing, are naturally rediscovered in the hierarchical geometry of transformer representations ( Tenney et al., 2019 ; Hewitt & Manning, 2019 ; Manning et al., 2020 ; De Vries et al., 2020 ; Koto et al., 2021 ; He et al., 2025c ; He et al., 2025d ; Ju et al., 2024 ) , although the reported ordering varies with architecture, task, and metric ( Belinkov & Glass, 2019 ; Rogers et al., 2020 ) . Despite these insights, the probing paradigm faces significant methodological criticism. A core debate concerns whether a probe reveals the model’s intrinsic knowledge or merely exploits the probe’s own capacity to learn the task from the embeddings ( Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ) . Theoretical work using information-theoretic criteria further suggests that probing results can be confounded by the ease of extracting information rather than its explicit presence ( Pimentel et al., 2020 ; Voita & Titov, 2020 ) , and related analyses show that probes can succeed on information the model does not actually use and that probe rankings are sensitive to design choices ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ; Kunz & Kuhlmann, 2022 ) . These limitations motivate the need for probe-free diagnostics, like our proposed framework, which directly measure selectivity without the interference of auxiliary training.
blocks.zh: 为了了解内部情况,社区转而采用诊断分类法,或“诊断法”。 沉积层分析显示,古典NLP输油管步骤,如部分螺旋标记和剖析,自然在变压器表示的几何结构中重新发现(Tenney等人,2019年;Hewitt & Manning,2019年;Manning等人,2020年;De Vries等人,2020年;Koto等人,2021年;He等人,2025c年;He等人,2025d年;Ju等人,2024年),尽管所报告的订单与建筑、任务和公制不同(Belinkov & Glass,2019年;Rogers等人,2020年)。 尽管存在这些见解,但探险范式面临重大的方法学批评. 一个核心争论是探测器是否揭示了模型的内在知识,还是仅仅利用探测器自身的能力从嵌入物中学习任务(Hewitt & Liang, 2019). 使用信息理论标准的理论工作进一步表明,通过易提取信息而不是其明确存在,检测结果可能令人困惑(Pimentel等人,2020年;Voita & Titov,2020年),以及相关分析表明,探测器可以在模型实际没有使用的信息上取得成功,探测器的排名对设计选择敏感(Ravichander等人,2021年;Kunz & Kuhlmann,2022年)。 这些限制促使需要无探测诊断,就像我们提议的框架那样,这种框架直接衡量选择性,而不受辅助培训的干扰。

blocks.en: Mechanistic interpretability instead attributes computations to concrete components, such as attention heads, feed-forward key–value memories, and circuits supporting factual recall ( Elhage et al., 2021 ; Geva et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2022 ) . At the finest granularity, neuron-level studies have linked individual units to translation and morphology features ( Bau et al., 2018 ; Dalvi et al., 2019 ) and to factual knowledge ( Dai et al., 2022 ) , while methodological work cautions that probe-based neuron ranking conflates information that is encoded with information the model actually uses ( Antverg & Belinkov, 2022 ) . Closest to our setting, causal mediation has localized neuron-level contributions to subject–verb agreement in English ( Finlayson et al., 2021 ) and across multilingual models ( Mueller et al., 2022 ) , although the reliability of such interventions depends on patching design choices and their documented failure modes ( Zhang & Nanda, 2023 ) . These studies show that unit-level analysis is feasible, but each targets one or two phenomena in isolation, leaving open how typical their findings are. Our study is systematic in both coverage and measurement: a single classifier-free index is applied uniformly to 68 paradigms nested under 13 phenomena and four domains, computed identically for every neuron in every layer, and replicated across seven checkpoints from four model families under a common set of pairing and threshold controls. To our knowledge, this is the first survey of neuron-level linguistic selectivity at this scale, and it shifts the question from whether selective neurons exist for a given construction to how common and how broad such selectivity is across the grammar as a whole.
blocks.zh: 机械可解释性将计算归结为混凝土元件,如注意头、向导键 -- -- 价值记忆以及支持事实召回的电路(Elhage等人,2021年;Geva等人,2021年;Meng等人,2022年)。 在最好的颗粒度上,神经元级研究将单个单位与翻译和形态特征(Bau等人,2018年;Dalvi等人,2019年)和事实知识(Dai等人,2022年)联系起来,而方法工作则告诫说,基于探测的神经元排名将信息与模型实际使用的信息编码(Antverg & Belinkov,2022年). 与我们的背景相近的是,因果调解对英语(Finlayson等人,2021年)和跨语言模式(Mueller等人,2022年)的动词协议有局部神经元级的贡献,尽管这种干预的可靠性取决于补丁设计选择及其记录的故障模式(Zhang & Nanda,2023年)。 这些研究表明,单位级分析是可行的,但每个分析都孤立地针对一两个现象,留下了它们的调查结果的典型性. 我们的研究在覆盖范围和衡量方面都是系统的:一个单一的无分类指数统一适用于在13个现象和4个领域下嵌入的68个范式,每层每个神经元都计算相同,并在一套共同的配对和阈值控制下在4个模范家庭的7个检查站复制。 据我们所知,这是在这个尺度上对神经元层次语言选择性的首次调查,它把特定构造是否存在选择性神经元的问题转移到这种选择性在整个语法中的共同程度和广泛程度.

blocks.en: We conduct our main analysis on the recent Qwen3-0.6B model ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , a 0.6-billion-parameter causal transformer released by Alibaba Group. Qwen3 adopts a decoder-only architecture with rotary position embeddings, multi-head self-attention, and feed-forward layers following the standard transformer design. Despite its relatively modest size, Qwen3-0.6B achieves strong performance across a wide range of language modeling and reasoning benchmarks, making it a suitable testbed for fine-grained interpretability studies. Its compact scale allows us to efficiently extract and analyze neuron-level activations across all layers.
blocks.zh: 我们主要分析阿里巴巴集团最近发布的Qwen3-0.6B型号(Yang等人,2025年),该型号为60亿参数的因果变压器. Quen3采用了只有解码器的架构,带有旋转位置嵌入,多头自留,以及遵循标准变压器设计的向导层. 尽管体积相对较小,Qwen3-0.6B在广泛的语言建模和推理基准上都取得了强效的性能,使它成为精细的可解释性研究的合适试验床. 它的紧凑尺度使我们能够有效地提取和分析所有层的神经元级激活.

blocks.en: This is the quantity the minimal-pair design is best suited to identify. Because the two members of a pair differ by as little as one token, some change in a neuron’s overall activation level is expected for a large fraction of units and reflects the lexical substitution as much as the grammatical contrast itself. A change in the relative ordering across items is more specific, in that it indicates that the neuron’s response depends on the grammatical status of each individual item. NSI is accordingly a measure of item-specific profile selectivity; mean-level effects constitute a complementary aspect of the paired contrast, which the uncentered cosine variant in Appendix G retains.

blocks.en: We recompute the score with Spearman rank correlation and cosine similarity while keeping the 68 paradigms, Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint, layer–neuron grid, and permutation-normalization procedure fixed. At the operational strong-selectivity threshold z > 2 z>2 , only 0.222 % 0.222\% of all tested layer–neuron units exceed the threshold under Spearman and 0.277 % 0.277\% under cosine. Thus, even these more permissive variants leave more than 99.7 % 99.7\% of units below threshold, preserving the central conclusion that strong single-unit selectivity is sparse.
blocks.zh: 我们用斯皮尔曼定级的关联性和余弦相似性来重算分数,同时保持68种范式,Quen3-0.6B检查点,层-中子网格,以及常态-常态化程序固定不变. 在操作性强选择性阈值z > 2 z > 2时,所有试验层-中微子单元中只有0.222% 超过Spearman的阈值,0.277% 超过余弦。 因此,即使这些更容许的变体也使99.7%以上的单位低于阈值,保持了集中结论,即强烈的单单位选择性是很少的。

blocks.en: Neither alternative is as well matched to our estimand. Each vector coordinate in our analysis is a repeated observation of the same scalar neuron across matched items, rather than a distinct representation feature. Spearman replaces activation values with ranks, making it invariant to monotonic rescaling but discarding graded response magnitudes and becoming sensitive to ties. Cosine does not center each neuron’s responses across items, so baseline and mean-level activation effects can appear as separability; its standardized scores can also become unstable when the permutation variance is extremely small. Pearson correlation instead centers each neuron’s item-wise response vector and directly measures whether the relative response pattern is preserved across the two members of a minimal pair. We therefore retain Pearson for the primary analysis and treat Spearman and cosine as complementary metric checks.
blocks.zh: 这两种选择都不符合我们的期待。 在我们的分析中,每个矢量坐标是重复地观测到同一鳞状神经元穿过匹配的物品,而不是一个明显的表示特征. 斯皮尔曼用阶梯取代激活值,使得单调缩放但丢弃分级反应量级而变得对连带敏感变得无用. 余弦不将每个神经元的响应中心跨项,因此基线和平均水平的激活效应可以表现为可分离性;其标准化的分数在常温差异极小时也会变得不稳定. 而皮尔逊关联则将每个神经元的逐项响应矢量集中,直接测量相对响应模式是否在最小对子的两个成员之间保存. 因此,我们保留皮尔逊进行初步分析,并将斯皮尔曼和余弦作为补充度量衡。

blocks.en: We compare the original item-matched grammatical–ungrammatical pairs with three deranged pairings, so no sentence remains paired with itself. Table 4 separates raw decorrelation from null-normalized selectivity. Random same-label pairs have raw scores near 0.5 because unrelated sentences are weakly correlated, but they produce no NSI > 2 {>}2 units. Conversely, cross-item good–bad pairs generate many sporadic outliers, showing that item alignment is necessary for interpreting the contrast. The original row here comes from the 200-permutation control run; its four above-threshold paradigms should not be conflated with the three paradigms in the 500-permutation main analysis.

blocks.en: For agreement paradigms, we compare the original pair with deletion of either the annotated critical token or a matched non-critical token. The clean test is the 10-paradigm one-prefix subset: the critical word directly realizes the good–bad contrast, so deleting it makes the pair identical or nearly identical. Table 5 shows that critical deletion nearly eliminates raw separability, whereas random deletion does not.

blocks.en: For example, deleting the critical verb from Paula references Robert versus Paula reference Robert leaves the same fragment, Paula Robert , on both sides. In two-prefix paradigms, however, the annotated shared target is not the contrasting word: deleting it can leave prefixes such as The students versus The student . Those six paradigms therefore do not constitute a clean contrast-removal test and are reported separately rather than used in the main conclusion. Normalized NSI after critical deletion is not emphasized because near-identical pairs also collapse the null variance, making the resulting z-score unstable.
blocks.zh: 例如,从保拉引用罗伯特对保拉引用罗伯特时删除了关键动词,两边留下了相同的碎片,保拉罗伯特. 然而,在两个前缀的范式中,附加注释的共享目标不是反比单词:删除它可以留下前缀,例如学生对 学生。 因此,这六个范式并不构成一个干净的对照清除测试,而是单独报告,而不是在主要结论中使用。 临界删除后的常态化的NSI没有被强调,因为近似对子也使无效差异崩溃,使得由此产生的z分数不稳定.

blocks.en: Figure 16 and Table 9 summarize the intervention results. Across the nine primary group comparisons ( k ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 } k\in\{5,10,20\} ), no targeted set is more damaging than same-size random controls at p < 0.05 p<0.05 . Although the left-branch top-20 intervention has a clear negative item-level effect, it is not extreme relative to the random interventions, and its bottom control is similarly negative. The auxiliary top-1 checks are also small and non-selective, but we do not treat single-coordinate ablation as the main causal test. We therefore conclude only that this intervention does not identify a behaviorally privileged high-NSI group, not that the selected dimensions are causally irrelevant. Redundancy, superposition, and the coarseness of residual-coordinate zeroing remain possible explanations for the lack of selective effects.
